The fully independent reference pipeline produces byte-identical output for 60 random small requests.

Let me run it for many more seeds/cases, including cases with larger patterns (σ ≤ 4, patterns up to 6) to stress the KMP structure. Let me bump the generator a bit and run several seeds.
